annotations.title: Search Verbex guides, templates and tools

description: Search Verbex guides and templates: practical guides (protocols and SOPs, lab notebooks, inventory, data integrity and GLP, equipment records, bench calculations) and the 16 lab documentation templates. Returns ids to pass to fetch, with titles and urls to cite. Not for calculations: to compute a mass, volume, dilution, master mix, LNP formulation or plate map, call that calculator directly.

query.description: What the scientist needs, in plain words, e.g. "freezer sample inventory" or "write an SOP".

type.description: Optional: only guides or only templates. "tool" lists the calculators, which you can call without searching.
